user.title: WebAuthn / Passkey Authentication Setup
user.description:
Configure passkey (WebAuthn / FIDO2) authentication for Home Assistant.

Both values must match the address you use to reach Home Assistant, otherwise the passkey ceremony fails in the browser with no useful error.

data_description.rp_id: The domain name of your Home Assistant instance, without scheme or port. Use `homeassistant.local` or `ha.example.com`.
data_description.rp_name: A human-readable name shown in passkey prompts, such as `Home Assistant`.
data_description.expected_origin: The full URL you use to reach Home Assistant, including the scheme, and the port when it is not the default.

error.invalid_rp_id: RP ID must be a plain domain name, without scheme or port.
error.invalid_origin: Expected origin must start with `https://` or `http://` and contain a host name.
error.origin_mismatch: The host in the expected origin must be the RP ID itself, or a subdomain of it. WebAuthn rejects any other combination.

abort.already_configured: WebAuthn / Passkey Authentication is already configured.
abort.invalid_yaml: The `webauthn_mfa` block in `configuration.yaml` is invalid and could not be imported. Fix it, or remove it and set the integration up from the UI.

init.title: WebAuthn / Passkey Settings
init.description:
Update the domain settings used for passkey ceremonies.

Home Assistant must be restarted for the new values to take effect.

Changing the RP ID invalidates every passkey already registered on this instance. They are cryptographically bound to the old domain and will have to be registered again.
